## Accessibility checklist

<!-- Check each item that applies. Explain any item you could not check. -->

- [ ] Uses semantic HTML (landmarks, headings, lists, buttons, links) before reaching for ARIA
- [ ] Every interactive element can be reached and used with a keyboard alone
- [ ] Keyboard focus is clearly visible and follows a logical order
- [ ] Form fields have visible labels that are programmatically associated
- [ ] Text and controls meet WCAG AA color contrast; color is not the only way meaning is shown
- [ ] Images and charts that convey meaning have text alternatives
- [ ] Link and button text makes sense out of context (no "click here")
- [ ] Motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion`
- [ ] Automated accessibility checks pass in CI
